text: Now I think it's clear that we have a resource inequality, an unequal distribution of financial resources. Much of the money is owned by a small percentage of the population of the world. So rather than a claim of population problem, could it also be that the people who are in possession of so much money are willing to pay for things and because they are in possession of that money and they can pay more, everyone else also has to pay more. Is that related to this? So yes, partly it does drive the price of things up. But companies also, as a business philosophy, they raise prices by 2% every year. The reason they do it, because that's what drives their business. That's why because somewhere we are conditioned to think.
